[[File:Great disdyakis dodecahedron.stl|thumb|3D model of a great disdyakis dodecahedron]]
In [[geometry]], the '''great disdyakis dodecahedron''' is a nonconvex [[Isohedral figure|isohedral]] [[polyhedron]]. It is the [[Dual polyhedron|dual]] of the [[uniform star polyhedron|uniform]] [[great truncated cuboctahedron]]. It has 48 triangular faces.

== Proportions==
The triangles have one angle of <math>\arccos(\frac{3}{4}+\frac{1}{8}\sqrt{2})\approx 22.062\,191\,157\,54^{\circ}</math>, one of <math>\arccos(-\frac{1}{6}-\frac{1}{12}\sqrt{2})\approx 106.530\,027\,150\,22^{\circ}</math> and one of <math>\arccos(-\frac{1}{12}+\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{2})\approx 51.407\,781\,692\,24^{\circ}</math>. The [[dihedral angle]] equals <math>\arccos(\frac{-71+12\sqrt{2}}{97})\approx 123.848\,891\,579\,44^{\circ}</math>.

== Related polyhedra==
The ''great disdyakis dodecahedron'' is topologically identical to the convex [[Catalan solid]], [[disdyakis dodecahedron]], which is dual to the [[truncated cuboctahedron]].
